articles.title: Spain, Morocco try to halt deadly rush on Spanish enclave after tens of thousands cross in a day - CNN
articles.description: Spain’s prime minister has rushed to Ceuta to defuse a growing crisis after an estimated 60,000 migrants poured into the Spanish enclave in north Africa from Morocco in a single day.
